page.notes: Right-margin note "ua pronuntiatione vnius dictionis, aut plu-" is a marginal note beside the first paragraph. Text is set in roman with italic passages; the page is a scan with some show-through and heavy ink damage. Words marked in the transcription with ? were not clearly legible; in particular the Greek-like word "Sophifta" and "Diogenià" were transcribed with uncertainty and the sentence "Quæ est captio ex Accentu? Cùm ex pra-" continues into the note. Several lines were partly obscured by the scan's left-edge damage and show-through from the reverse page; no further content could be reliably read. The last line of the scan, "Quomodo hæc captio vitabitur? Difiun-", breaks off at the foot of the printed text.
